scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently --names contracts,common,employees,attendance,gateway,web --prefix-colors gray,gray,blue,magenta,green,cyan "npm run dev -w @wfh/contracts" "npm run dev -w @wfh/nest-common" "npm run start:dev -w employees-service" "npm run start:dev -w attendance-service" "npm run start:dev -w gateway" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.dev:employees: npm run build:packages && npm run start:dev -w employees-service
scripts.dev:attendance: npm run build:packages && npm run start:dev -w attendance-service
scripts.dev:gateway: npm run build:packages && npm run start:dev -w gateway
scripts.db:seed: npm run build:packages && npm run seed:admin -w employees-service
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && npm run db:up && npm run db:seed
